headline.zh: 人工智能研究，扎实的工程实践。

discipline.zh: 人工智能与计算机科学

summary.en: I work across computer vision, machine learning evaluation and software development. My projects connect model experiments with usable systems, with particular attention to what the evidence supports and where it stops.
summary.zh: 我的工作涉及计算机视觉、机器学习评估与软件开发。我关注如何将模型实验落实为可使用的系统，同时清楚说明证据能够支持什么，以及它的局限。

en: I earned a BSc in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science at the University of Sheffield in July 2025. I then studied its MSc Artificial Intelligence programme in 2025–2026. My MSc dissertation has been submitted; final results and the degree award remain pending as of 16 October 2026.

My undergraduate project combined a facial-expression classifier with a Java/Tomcat web application. My MSc dissertation examined how different cell-segmentation pipelines affect quantitative measurements and downstream prediction in oral histology.

Alongside academic work, I develop software prototypes and maintain this bilingual portfolio. I am exploring doctoral study and suitable research or engineering opportunities, bringing together implementation, careful evaluation and clear technical communication.
zh: 我于 2025 年 7 月获得谢菲尔德大学人工智能与计算机科学理学学士学位，随后于 2025–2026 年修读该校人工智能硕士课程。硕士论文已提交；截至 2026 年 10 月 16 日，最终成绩及学位授予仍待确认。
本科项目将面部表情分类模型与 Java/Tomcat 网页应用结合。硕士论文研究不同细胞分割流程如何影响口腔组织学图像的定量测量及下游预测。
在学术项目之外，我也开发软件原型并维护这份双语作品集。目前正在探索博士研究与适合的研究、工程岗位，希望将实现能力、审慎评估和清晰的技术交流结合起来。

title.zh: 细胞分割与下游预测证据

subtitle.zh: 硕士论文 · 口腔组织学图像

summary.en: Comparing four segmentation pipelines to understand how cell measurements and prediction results change with the method used.
summary.zh: 比较四条细胞分割流程，研究分割方法如何影响细胞测量与后续预测结果。

body.en: How much do downstream quantitative measurements and predictions depend on the cell-segmentation pipeline? The dissertation studied oral H&E histology, separating segmentation quality, morphology measurements and predictive utility.
body.zh: 细胞分割流程会在多大程度上影响后续定量测量和预测？论文围绕口腔 H&E 组织学图像，分别考察分割质量、形态学测量及预测效用。

body.en: Compared QuPath, Cellpose-DINO, Cyto R-CNN and CSGO pipelines, examined their quantitative outputs, and assessed downstream models with attention to grouping and the independence of evaluation data.
body.zh: 比较 QuPath、Cellpose-DINO、Cyto R-CNN 与 CSGO 四条流程，分析它们产生的定量结果，并在下游模型评估中关注分组方式和评估数据的独立性。

body.en: The dissertation did not establish a clear gain from fusion over the image-only approach. This makes the distinction between a better segmentation output, more useful measurements and better predictions central to the interpretation.
body.zh: 论文未建立融合方案优于仅图像方案的明确证据。因此，需要区分分割输出更好、测量更有用与预测更准确这三个不同问题。

body.en: The work emphasised comparable pipelines, traceable processing, grouped evaluation and explicit limitations. The portfolio presents a professional summary of that work; the dissertation itself and research data are not distributed here.
body.zh: 工作重点包括可比较的流程、可追溯的处理步骤、分组评估与明确的局限说明。作品集仅展示职业简介级摘要，不分发论文全文或研究数据。

en: A submitted MSc dissertation comparing four named pipelines.
A distinction between segmentation, quantitative morphology and predictive utility.
An analysis that reports the absence of a clear fusion improvement.
zh: 已提交的硕士论文，比较四条明确命名的分割流程。
分别讨论分割、定量形态学和预测效用。
如实报告未观察到明确的融合增益。

en: Dissertation submission is not a confirmed degree award or peer-reviewed publication.
No clinical readiness, diagnostic performance or generalisation beyond the studied setting is claimed.
No raw medical images, research datasets or private repository contents are published.
zh: 论文提交不等于已授予学位或已发表同行评审论文。
不宣称具备临床应用条件、诊断能力或已在研究场景外验证泛化能力。
不公开原始医学图像、研究数据集或非公开代码仓库内容。

evidence.en: Supplied MSc dissertation, dated 30 September 2026, and the October 2026 application fact review.
evidence.zh: 依据所提供的 2026 年 9 月 30 日硕士论文及 2026 年 10 月申请事实核对资料。

original_title.en: Automated Extraction of Quantitative Data from Histology Images
original_title.zh: 组织学图像定量数据的自动提取

title.zh: 基于视觉信息的表情识别

subtitle.zh: 已完成本科项目 · 计算机视觉

summary.en: A complete image-to-prediction workflow, linking a Swin Transformer model with a responsive Java/Tomcat web application.
summary.zh: 将 Swin Transformer 模型与响应式 Java/Tomcat 网页应用连接，完成从图像输入到预测输出的完整流程。

body.en: Build an experimental application in which a user submits a facial image, the system validates and preprocesses it, a model estimates an expression category, and a clear interface returns the result.
body.zh: 构建一个实验性应用：用户提交面部图像，系统校验并预处理图像，模型估计表情类别，再通过清晰的界面返回结果。

body.en: Literature review, requirements analysis, architecture, front-end and server-side implementation, model integration, testing, results analysis and the final technical report.
body.zh: 完成文献综述、需求分析、架构设计、前后端实现、模型集成、测试、结果分析及最终技术报告。

body.en: The supplied report describes a Java/Tomcat application connected to a Python/PyTorch pipeline using a pretrained Swin Transformer. It discusses FER2013, RAF-DB and synthetic augmentation sources.
body.zh: 所提供的报告描述了连接 Python/PyTorch 流程的 Java/Tomcat 应用，使用预训练 Swin Transformer，并讨论 FER2013、RAF-DB 及合成增强数据来源。

body.en: The final report records 76.25% accuracy on its mixed test set. FER2013, RAF-DB and generated-image tests are separate experimental settings with different results; the mixed figure must not be relabelled as a single-dataset score. These are report-derived results, not independently reproduced measurements or estimates of a person’s internal emotional state.
body.zh: 最终报告记录的混合测试集准确率为 76.25%。FER2013、RAF-DB 与生成图像测试属于不同实验设置，结果各异，不能将混合测试数字改称某个单一数据集的成绩。这些数字来自原报告，本次未独立复现，也不能用于衡量一个人真实的内在情绪。

en: A working academic workflow covering interface, application logic and model inference.
Requirements, architecture, error handling and responsive interface documentation.
Model evaluation with confusion matrices and class-level discussion.
zh: 覆盖界面、应用逻辑与模型推理的学术项目流程。
包含需求、架构、错误处理和响应式界面的项目文档。
基于混淆矩阵及类别层面分析的模型评估。

en: Facial-expression labels are not direct measurements of internal emotion.
Dataset differences in pose, lighting, demographics and annotation affect generalisation.
The project is an academic demonstration; additional consent, validation and data controls would be needed for other settings.
zh: 面部表情标签不是对内在情绪的直接测量。
姿态、光照、人群及标注方式等数据差异会影响泛化。
该项目属于学术演示；其他应用场景仍需相应的同意、验证与数据管理措施。

evidence.zh: 依据所提供的 2025 年本科最终报告。

title.zh: Marginloom：AI 可靠性评估工作台

subtitle.en: Personal research prototype · Evaluation and human review
subtitle.zh: 个人研究原型 · 模型评估与人工复核

summary.en: An AI-assisted software prototype connecting prediction evaluation, calibration, selective prediction, human review and reproducible evidence reports.
summary.zh: 使用 AI 辅助开发的软件原型，将预测评估、校准、选择性预测、人工复核与可重复生成的证据报告连接起来。

role.en: Personal research and software prototype, developed with AI assistance
role.zh: 个人研究与软件原型，使用 AI 辅助开发

body.en: How can an evaluation workflow show which predictions to accept, which to review and what evidence supports the policy? Marginloom connects model outputs to inspectable metrics, review decisions and saved reports.
body.zh: 评估流程如何说明哪些预测可以接受、哪些需要复核，以及决策依据是什么？Marginloom 将模型输出与可检查的指标、复核决定和保存的报告连接起来。

body.en: The repository implements temperature scaling, risk-coverage and threshold exploration, validated JSON prediction imports, saved run and policy snapshots, local ensemble inference, persisted review notes and JSON evidence exports. A separate companion experiment demonstrates segmentation on synthetic images.
body.zh: 仓库实现了温度缩放、风险与覆盖率分析、阈值探索、JSON 预测导入校验、运行与策略快照、本地集成模型推理、复核备注持久化及 JSON 证据导出。另有独立实验在合成图像上演示分割。

body.en: A React and TypeScript interface connects to typed API handlers and SQLite/D1 persistence. Python and scikit-learn produce reproducible baseline models and evaluation exports. Workspace boundaries, validation and audit records support the demonstration workflow.
body.zh: React 与 TypeScript 界面连接类型化 API 及 SQLite/D1 持久化层。Python 与 scikit-learn 生成可复现的基线模型和评估结果。工作空间隔离、输入校验与审计记录支撑演示流程。

body.en: The public MIT-licensed repository includes source, model and prediction exports, documentation and tests. Its web, research and container GitHub Actions jobs passed on 4 October 2026 for the recorded verification commit. This portfolio update inspected those records; it did not rerun the complete prototype.
body.zh: 公开 MIT 许可仓库包含源码、模型与预测导出、文档及测试。记录的验证提交于 2026 年 10 月 4 日通过 web、research 与 container 三项 GitHub Actions 任务。本次作品集更新核实了这些记录，但未重新运行完整原型。

en: An inspectable prototype spanning evaluation, policy exploration and human review.
Public source, generated model artifacts and documented reproduction steps.
Recorded web, research and container checks for a specific October 2026 commit.
zh: 覆盖评估、策略探索及人工复核的可检查原型。
公开源码、生成的模型产物和复现步骤文档。
记录明确提交版本的网页、研究与容器检查结果。

en: A personal prototype developed with AI assistance, not evidence of a commercial business or customer deployment.
Demonstration datasets are generated or synthetic; no clinical validation or external production benchmark is claimed.
Historical checks do not certify every later change; browser file-saving and production readiness retain documented limitations.
zh: 使用 AI 辅助开发的个人原型，不代表已开展商业经营或已为客户部署。
演示数据为生成或合成数据，不宣称临床验证或外部生产环境基准成果。
历史检查不等于验证之后的每次修改；浏览器文件保存与生产应用准备仍有已记录的局限。

evidence.en: Public repository README, package metadata and verification documentation, plus GitHub Actions run 37196645885; inspected 16 October 2026.
evidence.zh: 依据公开仓库 README、依赖信息、验证文档及 GitHub Actions 运行 37196645885；核实于 2026 年 10 月 16 日。

subtitle.zh: 个人软件项目 · 全栈工程

summary.en: A Java MVC application for multi-currency financial reports, paired account transfers and administrator-managed inflation records.
summary.zh: 采用 Java MVC 的财务应用，支持多币种报告、账户转账配对分录，以及由管理员维护的通胀记录。

body.en: Accounts, transactions and positions feed a shared reporting workflow. Internal transfers use paired journal entries and are listed separately from income and expenses; ordinary transactions retain their original currency and account.
body.zh: 账户、交易与持仓共同支撑报告流程。内部转账使用成对记账分录，单独列出并排除在收入与支出之外；普通流水保留原币种和所属账户。

body.en: The existing Java MVC structure separates request handling, domain logic and persistence. Server-side account permissions control inflation maintenance, while transfer entries are written and reversed together in database transactions.
body.zh: 沿用现有 Java MVC 架构，将请求处理、领域逻辑与持久化分离。通胀维护权限由服务端账户身份决定，转账分录通过数据库事务成对写入与撤销。

body.en: Reports can switch between ten major currencies using the cached daily exchange-rate snapshot. Inflation and cash-flow tables support filtering and reversible column sorting, with monthly inflation readings recorded on the 15th.
body.zh: 报告可使用缓存的每日汇率快照，在十种主要货币之间切换。通胀与收支列表提供筛选和表头双向排序，每月通胀记录日期统一为15日。

body.en: The deployed application is available from the launch link. Sign in with an existing account to access personal financial records. The case study documents its architecture and workflows without publishing private accounts or operational data.
body.zh: 可通过入口访问已部署的应用，并使用已有账户登录查看个人财务记录。本案例介绍架构与工作流程，不公开私人账户或运行数据。

en: Multi-currency reporting within the existing MVC application.
Paired transfer records separated from external cash flow.
Server-controlled inflation maintenance and sortable data views.
zh: 在原有 MVC 应用中实现多币种报告。
将成对内部转账记录与外部收支分开。
服务端控制通胀维护权限，并提供可排序的数据视图。

en: No returns, customer numbers, revenue or production reliability claims are made.
Private accounts, credentials and transaction data are excluded from the linked source repository.
This page describes software engineering, not financial advice or a public trading service.
Application checks document specific behaviour; no independent security certification is claimed.
zh: 不宣称投资回报、客户数量、收入或生产环境可靠性。
链接的源码仓库不包含私人账户、凭据与交易数据。
此页面介绍软件工程，不提供投资建议或公开交易服务。
应用检查验证具体行为，不宣称取得独立安全认证。

evidence.en: Application source and targeted automated checks for the October 2026 update.
evidence.zh: 依据2026年10月更新的应用源码与针对性自动检查。

title.zh: OutcomeLab：交互式 AI 可靠性实验室

subtitle.en: Personal software project · Online learning and evaluation
subtitle.zh: 个人软件项目 · 在线学习与模型评估

summary.en: An interactive AI reliability lab where visitors challenge a classifier, teach corrections, and compare real learning on clean and shifted synthetic data.
summary.zh: 交互式 AI 可靠性实验室：挑战分类器、提交纠正，并在原始与分布偏移的合成数据上比较真实学习效果。

role.en: Personal portfolio project, developed with AI assistance
role.zh: 个人作品集项目，使用 AI 辅助开发

heading.en: Break it. Teach it. Measure it.

body.en: Try a synthetic support ticket, correct its category, then inspect measured changes in accuracy, confidence, calibration and the confusion matrix. Corrections update a real online classifier in an isolated session; reset and rollback make experiments reversible.
body.zh: 输入合成客服工单并纠正分类，查看准确率、置信度、校准指标与混淆矩阵的实际变化。每次纠正都会更新会话内独立的在线分类器，并支持重置与回滚。

body.en: A React and TypeScript interface connects to FastAPI and scikit-learn. Fixed data partitions, controlled drift experiments and JSON/CSV exports support inspection. Automated checks cover backend behaviour, browser workflows and Docker startup.
body.zh: React 与 TypeScript 界面连接 FastAPI 和 scikit-learn。固定数据划分、可控分布偏移实验及 JSON/CSV 导出便于检查；自动验证覆盖后端行为、浏览器流程与 Docker 启动。

en: Real incremental learning with per-session isolation and model rollback.
Inspectable clean and shifted evaluation, with reproducible experiment exports.
zh: 真实增量学习、会话隔离与模型回滚。
可检查的原始与偏移评估，以及可复现的实验导出。

en: Synthetic demonstration data; scores are illustrative rather than production benchmarks.
Personal, non-commercial portfolio demonstration; learning gains are not guaranteed.
zh: 使用合成演示数据，指标不代表生产环境基准。
个人非商业作品集演示，不保证每次学习都改善表现。

evidence.en: Public source and successful GitHub Actions run 39238690979; live HTTPS workflow verified on 19 October 2026.
evidence.zh: 依据公开源码及通过的 GitHub Actions 运行 39238690979；HTTPS 在线流程已于 2026 年 10 月 19 日核验。

description.en: Image preprocessing, model integration, cell-segmentation pipeline comparison and interpretation of class-level or downstream results.
description.zh: 图像预处理、模型集成、细胞分割流程比较，以及类别层面或下游结果的解读。

basis.zh: 本科项目与已提交硕士论文

description.zh: 基线对比、分组与泄漏检查、错误分析、可追溯实验、文献综合，以及明确的局限说明。

basis.zh: 研究项目与验证方法笔记

description.zh: Java 应用逻辑、持久化数据模型、界面设计、校验、错误处理及可维护的职责划分。

basis.en: Academic application and personal software projects
basis.zh: 学术应用与个人软件项目

description.en: Data preparation, exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, model comparison and reproducible interpretation of results.
description.zh: 数据准备、探索性分析、统计推理、模型比较及可重复的结果解读。

description.zh: 课程涵盖文本处理、语料准备、语言表示与 NLP 评估，也是持续关注的研究方向。

description.zh: 具备并行与 GPU 计算、可扩展机器学习、安全、分布式系统及专业责任方面的课程基础。

description.zh: 通过类型化接口与持久化应用流程，连接校准、策略探索、人工复核及可保存的证据。

basis.en: Marginloom personal prototype, developed with AI assistance
basis.zh: 使用 AI 辅助开发的 Marginloom 个人原型

title.en: Reliable visual segmentation under environmental and sensor shift
title.zh: 环境与传感器变化下的可靠视觉分割

question.en: When should a visual segmentation prediction be accepted or flagged as unreliable under changing conditions?
question.zh: 面对变化的条件，视觉分割预测何时可以接受，何时应标记为不可靠？

body.en: A proposed doctoral direction: investigate whether confidence calibration, feature novelty and perturbation sensitivity help identify unreliable segmentation predictions when data conditions change. These are future research questions, not completed experiments.
body.zh: 拟开展的博士研究方向：探索置信度校准、特征新颖性及扰动敏感性，是否有助于在数据条件变化时识别不可靠的分割预测。这些是未来研究问题，尚非已完成实验。

status_label.zh: 拟开展的博士研究方向

question.en: When do better image-processing outputs lead to more reliable measurements and useful predictions?
question.zh: 图像处理输出的改善，何时能转化为更可靠的测量与更有用的预测？

body.en: Cell segmentation, quantitative morphology, evaluation groups, domain differences and the relationship between upstream processing and downstream utility.
body.zh: 关注细胞分割、定量形态学、评估分组、领域差异，以及上游处理与下游效用之间的关系。

title.zh: 情绪、语境与多模态证据

question.en: How should a model use context and communicate uncertainty when observable signals do not uniquely determine emotion?
question.zh: 当可观察信号无法唯一确定情绪时，模型应如何使用语境并表达不确定性？

body.en: Building from facial-expression work towards questions about dialogue, contextual information, explanations and carefully bounded interpretation.
body.zh: 从面部表情项目出发，进一步关注对话、上下文信息、解释及有边界的结果解读。

question.en: What evidence is needed before a model result can support a decision or a software workflow?
question.zh: 模型结果要支持决策或软件流程，需要哪些证据？

body.en: Baseline comparisons, reproducible evaluation, failure analysis, transparent uncertainty and practical interfaces for inspecting results.
body.zh: 关注基线比较、可重复评估、失败分析、透明的不确定性表达及便于检查结果的实际界面。

question.en: How can mechanistic assumptions and measured data be connected without confusing model fit with explanation?
question.zh: 如何连接机制假设与测量数据，同时避免将模型拟合等同于解释？

body.en: An additional area of interest informed by coursework and literature reading: individual-based models, sensitivity, uncertainty and multiscale reasoning.

summary.en: A proposed doctoral direction: investigate whether confidence calibration, feature novelty and perturbation sensitivity help identify unreliable segmentation predictions when data conditions change. These are future research questions, not completed experiments.
